name: dotnet-impact
description: NCrunch-style impacted-test selection for .NET: builds a per-test-class coverage map in a background git worktree, then runs only the tests affected by your change. Includes a CLI for pre-commit hooks and AI coding agents.

dotnetImpact.autoBuildMap.description: Automatically build/refresh the impact map in the background when a workspace opens and unmapped test classes exist.

dotnetImpact.liveMapRefresh.description: After each affected run, re-collect coverage for the classes that ran (low-priority, background) so map rows stay fresh.

dotnetImpact.autoRunOnSave.description: Run affected tests automatically when a .cs file is saved.

dotnetImpact.debounceMs.description: Debounce interval after the last save before running affected tests.

dotnetImpact.testProjectGlobs.description: Globs used to identify test projects.

dotnetImpact.dotnetPath.description: Full path to the dotnet executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, DOTNET_ROOT, ~/.dotnet, system install locations).

dotnetImpact.maxParallelCoverageRuns.description: Concurrent per-class coverage collection runs during map building. 0 = auto (half your cores, max 8). Serial when the Coverlet fallback collector is in use.
